name: rich-incremental-jupyter-region-snapshots
instr:
Rich cannot capture immutable structural snapshots of notebook renderables without losing renderer-owned structure. Add snapshots that identify and replay incremental changes. Region collection must be explicitly enabled, compose through recursive rendering, and remain invisible in terminal and notebook output. Live displays must keep reliable revision history and recovery behavior.

`RegionKind` is a Enum. `JupyterRegion`, `region`, `JupyterSnapshot`, `ChangeKind`, `JupyterChange`, and `JupyterDiff` are public from `rich.jupyter`. `ChangeKind` is a Enum. Each region has a stable nonempty nested identity, ordered occurrence, semantic kind, and exact half-open terminal-cell range, including repeated, wide, and empty content. Snapshots remain immutable when sources change and preserve ordinary rendering's text, HTML, MIME filtering, styling, controls, spacing, and line boundaries. Align, Constrain, Columns, Bar, ProgressBar, Markdown, Panel, Tree, Syntax, and Pretty snapshots preserve renderer-owned semantic hierarchy, actual rendered order, and stable visible-content identities after every measurement, layout, traversal, wrapping, clipping, padding, expansion, and truncation decision, while decoration, wrapper space, unused bar space, pulse gaps, newline segments, and omitted content remain distinguishable from content and values.
